Which of your products is best for that, and why is it a good fit?

Sofia, if your main concern is finding something that feels well-made, stays comfortable, and disappears under clothes, I’d point you to the SPANXsmooth® Fit-To-You Mid-Thigh Short | Very Black. ✨

It’s a good fit if you’ve been let down by stiff, itchy, or roll-prone styles because it has seamless construction, lightweight breathable fabric, 400% stretch, and a dig-free feel. It’s especially strong for anti-chafe wear, no VPL, and everyday smoothing under dresses or skirts.

The one important callout, it offers minimal smoothing, so if what disappointed you before was not enough shaping or tummy control, I’d steer you to a stronger option instead. Let me know if you want light smoothing, medium shaping, or strong sculpting, and I’ll narrow it down fast.

Yes, for what it’s designed to do, reviews say it generally does hold up well. 🖤

For the SPANXsmooth® Fit-To-You Mid-Thigh Short | Very Black, customers most consistently call out:

very comfortable, soft, and breathable
nearly invisible under dresses
great for thigh chafing and no VPL

The main caveat is that the smoothing is minimal. A lot of reviewers love it for comfort and light everyday wear, but customers wanting firmer shaping or tummy control often feel it is too light.

a big difference with the SPANXsmooth® Fit-To-You Mid-Thigh Short. ✨

Smooth the legs so they sit flat at mid-thigh
Wear it as your underwear, the cotton gusset is made for that
Set the waistband at your natural waist
